caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved shirt with vertical red and blue stripes on an off-white or beige background. The shirt has a rounded collar with a placket extending down the front, which is detailed with horizontal stripes across a rectangular bib section. The sleeves are cuffed, each with a single button, and the cuffs are also striped. There are subtle seam lines along the shoulders, arms, and sides. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, less detailed line drawing of the back of the shirt, showing the same overall shape and the position of the rear collar and cuffs. The composition centers the colored and detailed frontal view of the shirt in the middle of the drawing, while the schematic back view is placed in the background, drawn with thin lines. The background is a plain, untextured beige.
title: Man's Shirt
